design.ray: pure variance increase: Q_I=N(0,r_hi(I)), r_hi(I)>1 solves r-1-log(r)=2I

simulation.seed_rule: insertion index j uses seedbase=21000000+j*1000; offset x uses that seedbase in the atomic shared-path simulator.
simulation.reproduction_note: All CP bounds reproduce from anchors[].joint_fail with n=6000, one-sided delta=1e-8; anchor j uses seedbase=21000000+j*1000.

transport.path_kl: For target I and anchor I_a on the pure-variance ray, D(path_I||path_Ia)=(64-x)*0.5[log(r_a/r)+r/r_a-1].
transport.cover_rule: Anchor I_a covers target I when the above path KL is <= kl(0.09||u_{a,x}) for every x, where u_{a,x} is the direct joint Clopper-Pearson upper bound.
transport.cover_construction: Intersect each anchor's interval over all offsets; the 11 inward-float64 intervals overlap into one connected band.
transport.result: the H=48/T0=700 direct-joint certificate covers the previously hardest pure variance-up direction continuously from KL I=1 through I=9.16422030458991; this is not a certificate for mixed mean/variance directions.

scope_and_caveats: Does not establish global radial monotonicity or all Gaussian KL>=1.
Float64 transport roots are moved one ulp inward but are not interval-arithmetic machine verification.
Direct joint event preserves neighboring-candidate dependence exactly in the simulator.
